torch_policy: Use parent ROCm torch unchanged; constrain its exact importlib.metadata version when installing dependencies.
working_directory: Dispatcher content-addressed copy of experiments/distillation; lane files are at cwd root.

local_validation.model_test_scope: Tiny randomly initialized Qwen3.5 with linear and full attention on CPU; gradient, base freeze, EMA, response alignment and exact reload. Not 4B GPU evidence.
local_validation.canonical_cli: All three configs validated from lane-only cwd with prewritten dispatcher config/packages. Obsolete --output is rejected.

scope: Synthetic device-rule acquisition, held-out inputs and deeper command compositions; no broad capability or SOTA claim.
design: Matched optimizer updates, question order, LoRA initialization, optimizer, frozen base, decoder support and rollout cap. Method-specific conditioning and supervised token counts differ and are reported.
adaptations: SDFT-style full-vocabulary forward KL along fresh student trajectories; teacher receives worked examples for other inputs, including verified operation explanations.
SDPO-style sampled reverse-KL score-function estimator with full-support sampling, verifier feedback and an EMA teacher; K=0 only.

Feedback reports wrong positions and device contracts, withholding expected final states on failed attempts. Successful generated attempts receive verifier confirmation. This is richer synthetic feedback than a scalar verifier.
No hyperparameter selection on test; one predetermined configuration and seed per initial method. Followup requires independent seeds and stronger controls.
replication_required_before_promising_cl: Independent model seed and new disjoint held-out data seed; initial config may only earn keep_for_replication.
cli_contract: Only --output-dir; no --output alias. Absolute or cwd-relative --config; pinned model_path is absolute.

conditional_real_hf_followup.candidate_sequence: Three disjoint tool-domain groups, only schema-valid single-call records; 64 training examples and separate held-out instructions per group.
conditional_real_hf_followup.verifier: Exact function name plus canonical parsed JSON arguments against golden_answer. No network tool execution; not execution-success evidence.
conditional_real_hf_followup.headroom_evidence: SDFT v2 reports Qwen2.5-7B ToolAlpaca accuracy 42 percent without demonstrations and 100 percent with them. This is evidence for that model and setup, not a Qwen3.5 teacher-advantage claim.
conditional_real_hf_followup.activation_gate: Only consider after synthetic pilot qualification and positive held-out replication; separately gate teacher advantage on the selected backbone and verify HF mirror against original ToolAlpaca source.

model_pin_validation: Revision and snapshot path match authoritative compute/models.json and outputs/nationalcompute-smoke/downloads.json; startup checks 40-hex revision, snapshot directory, config SHA256, both shards and total weight bytes.
